description: Epson Print and Scan delivers an exceptional print and scan experience in the Start screen for your Wi-Fi connected Epson All-In-One printers on Windows 8 so you can get your work done!  The Epson Print and Scan app provides you with familiar basic control that are enhanced for touch to compliment your creativity.  (Note: This device app does not support All-In-One devices on USB connection at this time. This device app does not support Windows 11. Searching for a printer may fail due to your network configuration. )
